title: Surreal Green Hound and Archers
description: A vibrant surreal painting dominated by a large stylized green dog covered in black spiral patterns, wearing a pink rope leash. Three identical pink-haired archers in green outfits draw bows with glowing green arrows toward a giant red eye containing a classical portrait of a woman. Hypnotic black and white spiral patterns and floating female faces fill the background.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a large lime-green dog covered in intricate black spiral maze patterns, wearing a thick pink rope leash. Three identical female archers with long bright pink hair, wearing green tunics and capes, simultaneously drawing bows that fire glowing green arrows. They aim toward a massive red eye that contains a classical grayscale portrait of a serene woman. The background consists of hypnotic black and white concentric spirals and floating female faces, psychedelic and mystical atmosphere.
